research_question: Does vitamin D supplementation reduce respiratory infections in adults?
criteria: Include human studies in adults that report a respiratory-infection outcome for vitamin D supplementation or exposure. Exclude ineligible designs (reviews, editorials, case reports), non-human or in-vitro populations, and any language outside the declared limit.
notes: Self-contained smoke fixture: eight title/abstract records with one preprint pair, one design exclusion, one language exclusion, one animal exclusion, one missing abstract and one reviewer disagreement that the standard resolves.
